\T\L\S\K\ASafety valve tripping \L\S\K\N
If a fault is detected in the oil circuit, in some situations the safety valve is tripped by the control unit. With each trip of the safety valve the readout is increased by the value 10. If no more faults are detected in a new driving cycle, the readout is reduced by 1. At a readout of 70 fault 18181 - Hydraulic pressure sender 1 -G193, signal too large - is entered\Y\S\K\N
J\L\S\K\N \L\B\K\N0\L\S\K\N: No tripping of the safety valve has been detected so far\Y\S\K\N J\L\S\K\N \L\B\K\N greater than 0\L\S\K\N: One or more trips of the safety valve was detected.
Example: If a value of 30 is measured during a driving cycle, and the ignition then switched off and back on again, a new driving cycle executed, then the measurement read again and a readout of 29 found, the oil circuit is OK again. However, if the readout is 40 the problem in the oil circuit persists.
